title: Affirmative agreement across all six persons
summary: Choose the correct affirmative olla form from the complete paradigm.
objectives: Use agreement in varied short contexts.

sections.title: The complete affirmative set
paragraphs: A verb paradigm is the organized set of forms for all grammatical persons. The olla paradigm is olen, olet, on, olemme, olette, ovat.
Read the subject before choosing. Similar-looking forms still belong to different people.

sections.title: Use meaning and ending together
paragraphs: The English words am, are, and is do not map to one Finnish form. Finnish agreement also distinguishes we, plural or polite you, and they.
Check both person and number before writing the form.

steps: Select olen from the six-form paradigm.
Select olette, including for polite singular address.

commonMistakes: Do not choose from the English word “are” alone.
Do not confuse olemme and olette.
Check the subject before reading the context.
